"I'm carrying a story with me — a story that, God willing, will become a success story. I carry that story with me into every fight. "We didn't leave our country by choice. It was because of the difficult living conditions and the wars that took place, so we were forced to leave and move to another country to build a life there." The 24-year-old said he is not at the Games merely to make up the numbers. "The preparations were really intense, and our goal isn't just to participate — we're hoping to achieve something, God willing." HUNAIDI THANKS IOC Hunaidi also expressed gratitude to the International Olympic Committee, the OCA, and World Taekwondo for helping her live out this dream. "Sport has changed me for the better. I've become a different person. I have hope now, and I have dreams and ambitions for the future," the 18-year-old said. "We've seen a different side of life, and we now have hope. We've learned that nothing is impossible. Things can be difficult sometimes, but with time, you can overcome them and move forward." Shiva Kesavan, vice chair of the OCA Athletes' Committee, praised the pair as role models, who have been integrated into the wider Asian Games community. "It can be overwhelming for them to come straight into the Asian Games and see the top continental talents here," Kesavan told Reuters. "They have their personal goals, but more importantly, they're now part of a community. They will make friends, who'd support them and this is the human connection that sport is all about. "So I tell them 'No pressure, you are already role models. We all look up to you. So just go there, have a good time, and express yourself through your sport.' "

Source: Reuters

item.title: Wegovy-maker Novo shares slump as management grilled on pricing, M&A
item.description: Novo Nordisk shares slid as much as 9% on Monday as executives faced tough questions from analysts over the drugmaker's pricing power and dealmaking strategy ahead of looming patent expiries.
item.dc:creator: Patrick Wingrove
item.content:encoded: Novo Nordisk (NOVOb.CO) shares slid as much as 9% on Monday as executives faced tough questions from analysts over the drugmaker's pricing power and dealmaking strategy ahead of looming patent expiries. Novo aims to launch more than five blockbuster drugs by 2030 and deliver more than 150 billion Danish crowns ($23 billion) in pipeline sales in 2035, CEO Mike Doustdar said at the drugmaker's capital markets day in London. The company is racing to reassure markets that it can navigate patent expirations for semaglutide — the active ingredient in its blockbuster anti-obesity drug Wegovy and diabetes medicine Ozempic — in the early 2030s. The Danish drugmaker's fortunes have reversed sharply since the 2021 arrival of Wegovy propelled its valuation above $600 billion. Novo shares have tumbled more than 70% from their record highs in the face of stiff competition from U.S. rival Eli Lilly (LLY.N) . NOVO FACES PRESSURE FROM GENERICS, NEW RIVALS Lilly’s competing injection, Zepbound, is on track to outsell Wegovy by upwards of $7 billion this year, according to LSEG data. Seeking to soothe market jitters, Novo last year started a cost-cutting drive, disclosing on Monday that staff departures have reached 13,000 following an initial 9,000 layoffs and 4,000 subsequent exits. However, analysts on Monday pressed management on their pricing assumptions, questioning whether next-generation drugs can sustain premium price points once semaglutide loses exclusivity. Markus Manns, a portfolio manager at investor Union Investment, told Reuters that Novo's 2030 sales target, projecting only stable margins, was slightly underwhelming - if not a big surprise. "Considering all the pressures Novo will be facing in the coming years such as biosimilars in Canada, Brazil and China and heavy competition starting in '28 from Amgen, Pfizer etc, the guidance seems reasonable," he said. Novo shares recovered some early losses and were down 4.7% by 1124 GMT. FOCUS ON M&A DEALS TO BOLSTER PIPELINE Novo executives said the drugmaker's balance sheet can support larger acquisitions rather than just small bolt-on deals and clarified that its over 150 billion crown target is based on internal, risk-adjusted assets and excludes any future M&A. Management on Monday also detailed a multi-year rollout for the drugmaker's next-generation obesity injectables, targeting a launch of its CagriSema combination early next year, followed by standalone cagrilintide and high-dose CagriSema in 2028, before advancing zenagamtide. Chief Scientific Officer Martin Holst Lange said Novo now plans to launch oral and injectable zenagamtide simultaneously, rather than rolling out the shot first. Doustdar said Novo aims to reach more than 60 million patients globally by 2030 and scale up manufacturing tenfold to supply 15 million patients with oral obesity therapies by the end of the decade. Novo is also accelerating expansion of its portfolio of pills and aims to have at least five oral assets in clinical trials before the end of this year. Doustdar said Novo's oral Wegovy pill has achieved a record 7 million prescriptions in the U.S. to date, noting that 90% of those sales are flowing through direct cash-pay channels. ($1 = 6.5096 Danish crowns)

New air traffic control failure delays flights at UK airports

Manchester, Glasgow and Belfast airports were experiencing delays, and London's Gatwick and City Airports said there would be some disruption.

Passengers stand with their luggage underneath an information display board in the South Terminal of London Gatwick Airport near Crawley, southern England, on Sep 9, 2026, following the second day of major disruption due to an issue affecting the NATS air traffic control systems. (File photo: AFP/Justin Talls)

LONDON: Flights at several British airports were delayed on Monday (Sep 21) due to an air traffic control failure, Britain's NATS air traffic control provider said, less than two weeks after a separate issue halted flights across the country . Manchester, Glasgow and Belfast airports were experiencing delays, which NATS said were related to an issue at its Prestwick centre in Scotland, while London's Gatwick and City Airports said there would be some disruption. British transport minister Heidi Alexander, who has been considering the future of NATS Chief Executive Martin Rolfe after repeated failures, said the problem had now been fixed, and systems were resuming. "I know this will be deeply frustrating for passengers after the previous issue," she said on X.

Ryanair, Europe's biggest airline, said 25,000 of its passengers were facing delays as a result of Monday's issue and repeated its calls for Rolfe to resign. Rival airline easyJet said it had cancelled some flights while British Airways warned its customers that they were likely to experience disruption on Monday. NEW ISSUE BEHIND DELAYS NATS said that Monday's delays were caused by a connectivity issue "unrelated to the issue two weeks ago", when about 2,000 flights were cancelled owing to a software defect, affecting hundreds of thousands of people. Cancellations on Monday had reached 24 by 8.58am GMT (4.58pm, Singapore time). "Airports south of Manchester are broadly unaffected, however, flights heading north and flights departing Scottish airports are currently subject to some delay," NATS said in a statement. A previous outage in August 2023 cost airlines 100 million pounds (US$134 million) and caused travel chaos. EasyJet said that Monday's disruption underlined weakness in the air traffic operator's systems. "This, once again, calls into question the resilience of NATS' systems and demonstrates the need for firm actions to prevent these repeated failures," easyJet said.

item.title: 人民元、22年6月末以来の高値で通常取引終了 首脳会談控え上昇容認との声
item.description:
Jiaxing Li
［香港 ２１日 ロイター］ - 中国人民元は２１日の通常取引を１ドル＝６．６９５５元と、２０２２...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
人民元、22年6月末以来の高値で通常取引終了　首脳会談控え上昇容認との声 18:43 配信

タイ・バンコクの銀行で2023年1月撮影　REUTERS/Athit Perawongmetha

Jiaxing Li

［香港　２１日　ロイター］ - 中国人民元は２１日の通常取引を１ドル＝６．６９５５元と、２０２２年６月３０日以来の高値で終えた。今週の米中首脳会談を前に、中国人民銀行（中央銀行）が元高抑制姿勢を緩めた。

人民元は一時１ドル＝６．６９５０元と、２３年１月１６日以来の高値を付けた。オフショア人民元はアジア時間で約０．０３％高の１ドル＝６．６９４６元で推移した。

人民銀は取引開始前に対ドル基準値を６．７４８７元と２３年２月３日以来の元高水準に設定した。基準値はほぼ１年にわたり市場予想より元安水準に設定され、人民銀が元の上昇ペースを抑えようとしていると受け止められてきた。しかし今月に入り基準値の元高方向への設定が加速し、人民銀が抑制姿勢を緩めたとの見方が出ている。

ゴールドマン・サックスのアナリストはリポートで、米中首脳会談を控えた時期の基準値の強さは、過去の実績と一致しており、オフショア・スポット相場がさらに上昇する余地が拡大していると指摘。

「首脳会談が開催されるという事実は、安定した貿易関係の維持に寄与するはずだ。中国の政策当局者は持続的かつ緩やかな元高を容認することに引き続き安心感を持つだろう」と述べた。

一方、ＯＣＢＣはノートで、元上昇と相対的な安定は米中交渉にとって建設的な背景を作り、競争的な通貨切り下げとの新たな批判の余地を減らすものの、今回の人民銀の動きを持続的な元高サイクルの始まりと解釈することには慎重であるべきだと指摘した。「米中金利差が大きく、国内のファンダメンタルズが依然として弱い状況を踏まえると、最近の上昇の一部は人民元の根本的な再評価というより、首脳会談に向けた政策主導の安定化を反映している可能性がある」と述べた。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：前途開けた中国人民銀行、「バズーカ砲」不要か コラム：人民元／円相場の記録的高騰に見る円の構造的脆弱性＝植野大作氏 焦点：人民元リスクは上振れ方向、当局が抑制で対応か 焦点：人民元国際化に低金利の追い風、起債や融資が拡大 コラム：人民元高が堅調な中国輸出の妨げとならない理由 最終更新: 9/21(月) 18:43 ロイター

item.title: India-New Zealand free trade pact to come into force on October 20 after ratification
item.description: A free trade agreement between India and New Zealand, signed in April, will come into force on October 20, Indian trade minister Piyush Goyal said on Monday, as New Delhi seeks to boost exports and attract investment amid shifts in global trade.
item.dc:creator: Manoj Kumar, Shivangi Acharya
item.content:encoded: A free trade agreement between India and New Zealand, signed in April, will come into force on October 20, Indian trade minister Piyush Goyal said on Monday, as New Delhi seeks to boost exports and attract investment amid shifts in global trade. Both countries ratified the pact on Monday, with New Zealand Trade and Investment Minister Todd McClay exchanging documents with India's High Commissioner to New Zealand, Muanpuii Saiawi, at Parliament. The deal comes as US President Donald Trump has [USN:L1N45904J TEXT:"signed a law"] allowing tariffs of up to 100% on countries such as India for buying Russian oil. India has accelerated efforts to diversify export markets away from the US, its biggest market, through trade agreements with major economies, including Britain and the European Union. New Zealand's parliament last week passed [USN:L1N458004 TEXT:"legislation"] needed to implement the agreement. "The New Zealand-India FTA will level the playing field and unlock access for Kiwi businesses in one of the fastest growing markets in the world," McClay said in a statement. Under the [USN:P8N40Q07B TEXT:"agreement"], tariffs on about 95% of New Zealand exports to India will be eliminated or reduced when the deal is fully implemented. McClay said 57% of New Zealand exports will be tariff-free from day one, including sheep meat, wool and coal, and more than 95% of forestry and wood exports. Duty-free coverage will later rise to 82%, while the remaining 13% will face steep tariff cuts. The agreement gives all Indian goods duty-free access to New Zealand and eases mobility rules for students and workers. Wellington has also agreed to invest $20 billion in India over the next 15 years. New Zealand exporters will receive preferential quota access for apples, kiwifruit and albumins. Wine tariffs will fall from 150% to either 25% or 50% over 10 years, depending on product value. Prime Ministers Christopher Luxon and Narendra Modi have committed to doubling bilateral trade by 2030, from about $2.3 billion in the 12 months through June. "India and New Zealand show that we can agree to terms that are beneficial for trade and businesses," McClay said via video conference, citing rising tariffs and global business uncertainty. India said last week that the new measures to levy tariffs over the purchase of Russian oil could impact bilateral ties with the United States, in a sharp response to the passing of the law.

item.title: Wall St futures rise as AI stocks gain, oil prices slide - Reuters
item.description: Wall St futures rise as AI stocks gain, oil prices slide Reuters

item.title: Stocks advance after Bessent says talks with China were successful before Trump-Xi meeting
item.description: Asian shares advanced Monday ahead of the expected meeting between U.S. President Donald Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping this week in Washington, which could cover trade, artificial intelligence ...
item.dc:creator: The Associated Press
item.content:encoded: HONG KONG — Asian shares advanced Monday ahead of the expected meeting between U.S. President Donald Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping this week in Washington, which could cover trade, artificial intelligence and geopolitics. U.S. futures were higher after Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent told reporters following talks Sunday with Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng in New York that the U.S. had “a very successful engagement” with the Chinese side. Technology stocks in Asia also moved higher on the AI boom even as American tech leaders called for a slowdown in AI development over safety concerns. South Korea’s Kospi rose 1.7 per cent to 7,007.72. Samsung Electronics jumped five per cent, while memory chipmaker SK Hynix climbed 0.6 per cent. Taiwan’s Taiex was up 1.1 per cent, with its leading AI chipmaker Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co., or TSMC, adding 0.8 per cent. Hong Kong’s Hang Seng advanced 0.9 per cent to 24,975.58. The Shanghai Composite index gained one per cent to 3,949.91. Markets in Japan were closed Monday and will remain closed through Wednesday for holidays. Australia’s S&P/ASX 200 was almost unchanged at 8,731.90. India’s Sensex rose 0.7 per cent. On Sunday, Bessent said talks with China touched on trade and AI. China and the United States have been discussing reciprocal tariff reductions on US$30 billion worth of goods from each side. In Beijing, China’s Foreign Ministry on Monday confirmed that Xi will pay a state visit to the U.S. between Sept. 23 and 25. Experts and policymakers believe trade, tariffs, AI safety, among other items, are likely to be on the agenda. The war in Iran and developments in the Middle East and ties between China and Iran could also be discussed. Oil prices fell more than two per cent early Monday as vessel traffic and energy flows through the Strait of Hormuz picked up, although the Strait has remained largely closed and uncertainty persisted over U.S.-Iran tensions. Tensions between Saudi Arabia and the Iran-backed Houthis and Saudi Arabia’s closure of a key oil pipeline also continued to add pressure to global oil supplies. Brent crude, the international standard, fell 2.1 per cent to $101.65 per barrel. It was at roughly $72 a barrel in late February, before the start of the war in Iran. Benchmark U.S. crude lost 2.3 per cent to $93.86 per barrel. Oil supply concerns remain elevated, ING commodities strategists Ewa Manthey and Warren Patterson wrote in a commentary Monday. However, they said profit-taking by investors after the recent jump in oil prices, together with hopes for constructive discussions at this week’s U.N. General Assembly and at the Trump-Xi meeting, helped improve market sentiment. The U.S. dollar rose to 157.25 Japanese yen from 156.81 yen. The euro was trading at $1.1473, down from $1.1483. Wall Street’s benchmark S&P 500 added 0.2 per cent on Friday. The Dow Jones Industrial Average edged down 0.2 per cent, and the technology-heavy Nasdaq composite gained 0.4 per cent. Investors are also watching the bond market as the yield on the U.S. 10-year Treasury hit five per cent and the Federal Reserve last week decided to raise rates for the first time in three years. The yield on the U.S. 10-year Treasury was at around 4.97 per cent early Monday. The Bank of Japan last week also raised rates to a 31-year high. Government bond yields have been elevated since the war also because of growing inflationary pressure from the war-driven energy shock as well as rising U.S. national debt. Chan Ho-him, The Associated Press

item.title: Wall St futures rise as AI stocks rally, crude prices fall
item.description: US stock futures were higher on Monday, driven by gains in AI shares as Treasury yields took a beating and oil slid 2% to hit an 11-day low on signs of progress in Middle East talks.
item.dc:creator: Johann Cherian, Tharuniyaa Lakshmi
item.content:encoded: US stock futures were higher on Monday, driven by gains in AI shares as Treasury yields took a beating and oil slid 2% to hit an 11-day low on signs of progress in Middle East talks. While Washington and Tehran continued to exchange new threats through the weekend, US President Donald Trump said he would be [USN:L1N45C06F TEXT:"open to meeting"] Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian, who is expected in New York this week for the UN General Assembly. Doomsday calls from bosses at top AI companies a week ago had sparked a rout, but those concerns seemed to dissipate on Monday as investors focused on indications [USN:L1N45A11J TEXT:"spending"] on developing the technology was [USN:L1N45A0H1 TEXT:"still expanding"]. Chip companies such as Intel (INTC.O) rose 5.3%. Marvell (MRVL.O) added 2.2%, Meta (META.O) climbed 2.6% and Dell (DELL.N) advanced 2.3%. Accenture (ACN.N) also gained and was up 6.1% after [USN:L4N45A1ON TEXT:"p"][USN:L4N45A1ON TEXT:"artnering with Anthropic"] to invest $2 billion in AI evaluation. "We are past the local peak in (Middle East) tensions, and we should see some move towards normalization in the coming weeks. Our theory remains that the first couple of weeks of October could be a sweet spot for some sort of fudge between (the) US and Iran," said Mohit Kumar, an economist at Jefferies. A fall in oil prices eased the pressure on equities as the 10-year US bond yield slipped below the keenly watched 5% mark. Energy-price-sensitive airlines such as Delta (DAL.N) and American (AAL.O) gained more than 1.5% each. Still, investors are wary of the interest-rate outlook after a recent pickup in inflation prompted the US Federal Reserve to raise rates for the first time in three years. Markets see a 53% chance of another rate hike next month, CME's FedWatch showed. Commentary from at least 10 central bank policymakers is due this week. Chicago Fed President [USN:L6N45C08M TEXT:"Austan Goolsbee"] said there was "no ambiguity" about the need for higher interest rates, with inflation pressures now moving beyond tariffs and energy prices to strong demand. At 07:09 a.m. ET, Dow E-minis rose 404 points, or 0.78%, S&P 500 E-minis gained 51.25 points, or 0.67%, and Nasdaq 100 E-minis added 310.75 points, or 1.04%. A diplomatic breakthrough between the [USN:L6N45B02X TEXT:"United States and Denmark"] over the weekend regarding the status of Greenland also aided sentiment and will likely allay trade tensions between the countries. US-listed shares of companies exposed to Greenland advanced. Critical Metals (CRML.O) soared 27.1%, Greenland Mines (GRML.O) shot up 90.8% and Greenland Energy (GLND.O) more than doubled. The [USN:L8N45A068 TEXT:"China-US summit"] on Thursday could likely touch on topics including potentially extending the trade truce between the two superpowers, the Iran war as well as regulation on AI advancement. Scott Bessent and Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng concluded talks on Sunday during which the US Treasury secretary proposed a new mechanism for [USN:L6N45D021 TEXT:"AI safety notifications"]. Bitcoin , a key marker of risk appetite, rose 4.3% to hit a more-than-seven-month high, lifting Coinbase (COIN.O) and Strategy (MSTR.O) over 5% each. Warner Bros (WBD.O) was up 7.1% after a [USN:L4N45D04F TEXT:"report"] Paramount (PSKY.O) discussed concessions in advanced settlement negotiations with California's attorney general that could help close the proposed merger between the two companies.

item.title: Merz clings on after German election 'disaster'
item.description: Chancellor Friedrich Merz's conservative party tumbled to its worst regional election defeat in postwar Germany and members of his coalition clashed over his unpopular reform agenda.
item.dc:creator: Andreas Rinke, Matthias Williams
item.content:encoded: Chancellor Friedrich Merz was clinging to power on Monday after his conservative party [USN:L1N45C01D TEXT:"tumbled"] to its worst regional election defeat in postwar Germany and members of his coalition clashed over his unpopular [USN:L8N4340M1 TEXT:"reform agenda"]. Merz himself described Sunday's loss in the northeastern state of Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania as a "disaster" as his party for the first time missed the 5% threshold for entering a state parliament. This even occurred in a state that was the former stronghold of Merz's predecessor and party rival, Angela Merkel. The far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD) took first place. While it fell well short of a majority, it was the second time the party had topped a state election within a month, which it sees as building momentum towards national power. Merz's party also bled votes in a second election in the state of Berlin, which could see the [USN:L1N45C05W TEXT:"far-left Die Linke party"], the descendants of the Communist party that once ran East Germany, take power in a coalition after winning most seats. GERMAN CHANCELLOR'S FUTURE IN THE BALANCE Sunday's results may not prove a knock-out blow for Merz, but his low approval ratings and the AfD's surge have left his future [USN:L8N4571NP TEXT:"in the balance"]. Several conservative state premiers met on Sunday to take stock after publicly backing Merz in an open letter last week. "The meeting was not about a revolt or a plot against Chancellor Merz," one of the participants of the meeting told Reuters. "However, there was agreement that the Chancellor needs to deliver more following the CDU's difficult results in the state elections." Within minutes of the results coming in on Sunday, Merz in televised remarks vowed to press on with his reform agenda that he says is vital to revive sluggish growth in Europe's largest economy and keep it globally competitive. But members of his centre-left coalition partner, the Social Democrats, pushed back. That includes Manuela Schwesig, the popular incumbent state premier of Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania, who has sharply criticised the federal government's pension reforms. Schwesig said she was "very irritated" by Merz's remarks. "I think more humility is actually called for on the part of the Chancellor," she told the ARD broadcaster. The economy has been struggling since the pandemic to regain momentum, with competition from China as well as higher energy prices challenging its export-driven economic model. Some business leaders urged Merz to stay the course. "Economic strength is not built by waiting, but by actively shaping the future. We cannot afford to lose momentum now," said Jochen Hanebeck, the CEO of chipmaker Infineon (IFXGn.DE) , in a LinkedIn post. BITTER PILL FOR GERMANY'S IMMIGRANT COMMUNITIES The AfD party leads in national opinion polls but has been kept from power by the other main parties' refusal to work with it, in a policy known as the "firewall" that has been increasingly scrutinised as the AfD gained strength. Its hardline stance on immigration has left some in Germany of migrant background [USN:L8N44Z0U7 TEXT:"questioning their future"]. "The fact that the AfD is in the lead is quite a bitter pill to swallow," said Yasmin Goudarzi, an educational scientist. In Berlin, Die Linke topped the polls in a state election for the first time on a campaign to nationalise housing from corporate landlords and put a cap on rents, echoing the rise of New York Mayor [USN:L6N42W12S TEXT:"Zohran Mamdani"]. Merz, who was elected last year on a promise to return Germany to growth, has struggled to win over voters, as a stream of communication missteps served to compound resentment over unpopular pension, tax and healthcare reforms. Schwesig, sometimes seen as a potential next SPD national leader, is likely to remain in power in her state. Schwesig said the AfD had won votes by criticising [USN:L1N4500XU TEXT:"Germany's support for Ukraine"], a message that the [USN:L8N45D0Q6 TEXT:"Kremlin also capitalised on"] in comments by its spokesperson on Monday. The AfD wants to restore ties with Moscow and characterises sanctions on Russia as self-sabotaging, by cutting off access to Russia's vast cheap energy resources. Schwesig had at one time supported the Nord Stream pipelines carrying Russian gas through her Baltic Sea coast state into Germany before they were blown up in 2022, but later changed her position. "The troublemakers who voted for the AfD clearly weren't paying attention in history class," said Detlef Spelker, a passerby in Schwerin. "We've been in a similar situation before, almost 100 years ago. Inflation, problems with jobs, nobody had any money. We'll see what this brings now."

item.title: Apple Pay launch in October: Cards at launch, but UPI could be big question
item.description: Apple Pay could launch in India as early as October with credit card support, entering a market dominated by UPI. Here is an explainer on what is Apple Pay and how it could work ...
item.dc:creator: Sweta Kumari
item.content:encoded: For years, iPhone users in India have had to rely on third-party payments apps such as PhonePe, Google Pay and Paytm for digital payments. That could change soon, with Apple preparing to bring Apple Pay to India as early as October, giving users a way to make payments directly through Apple Wallet and supported devices. The reported initial rollout will focus on credit cards, with Axis Bank expected to be among the first banking partners. Apple Pay, however, is entering a market unlike most countries where it already operates. India has built a vast digital payments ecosystem around the Unified Payments Interface (UPI), which accounted for about 84 per cent of digital payment transaction volume, according to the Press Information Bureau (PIB). The timing is also significant, with a new 0.4 per cent merchant discount rate (MDR) for certain UPI merchant transactions set to take effect from October 15.What is Apple PayApple Pay is Apple's digital wallet and payment service. It allows users to add an eligible credit or debit card to the Wallet app on an iPhone, Apple Watch and other supported Apple devices, and then use the device to make payments at contactless terminals, as well as on websites and in apps. For an in-store payment, an iPhone user can double-click the side button, authenticate using Face ID or a passcode, and hold the phone near a contactless payment terminal. Apple Pay uses Near Field Communication (NFC) to communicate with the terminal. Apple Watch users can also make payments using the service. Instead of sending the actual card number to the merchant, Apple Pay uses a device-specific number and a transaction-specific security code. Apple says the original card number is not stored on its servers or shared with merchants.How will Apple Pay work in IndiaReuters recently reported that the India rollout is expected to begin with Axis Bank credit cards. Apple is also in discussions with HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank, although commercial terms with those banks had not been finalised at the time of the report. According to the report, Apple Pay is expected to initially support credit cards on global networks such as Visa and Mastercard. Users would be able to save their card details in Apple Wallet and make contactless payments by tapping their iPhone or Apple Watch at NFC-enabled point-of-sale terminals. This means the initial rollout is expected to focus on card payments rather than trying to replace India's broader digital payments system.How is Apple Pay different from PhonePe and Google PayThe major difference is the payment system behind them. PhonePe and Google Pay are major UPI-based payment apps in India. UPI allows users to transfer money directly between bank accounts and make payments using methods such as QR codes and UPI-enabled applications. Reuters says PhonePe and Google Pay together account for about 80 per cent of UPI payment value. Apple Pay, in its reported initial India configuration, is different because it is built around cards stored in Apple Wallet. Instead of opening a payment app and scanning a QR code, users can authenticate on their Apple device and tap it against a contactless terminal. Simply put, PhonePe and Google Pay primarily connect users to India's UPI payment rail, while Apple Pay's reported initial India rollout would connect a user's card to Apple devices and card networks.What India-specific features are known so farThe most significant India-specific detail is the expected banking arrangement. As stated above, Apple is expected to kick off Pay with Axis Bank credit cards and may add more banks over time. HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank are among the lenders with which Apple has held discussions. As reported previously, Apple had been negotiating with major credit card issuers over the share of interchange fees it would receive from transactions. According to the report, Apple takes 15-20 basis points of interchange fee on every Rs 10,000 purchase. A basis point is one-hundredth of a percentage point. The fee would not be charged separately to the customer or merchant. Instead, it would come from the bank's earnings from card transactions.Will Apple Pay support UPIApple Pay is not expected to support UPI when it launches in India. Business Standard reported in August that the service would initially support credit cards on global networks such as Visa and Mastercard. For Apple Pay to offer UPI transactions, Apple would need clearance from the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) and a sponsor bank to route the payments. A more recent report citing Bloomberg said Apple Pay could eventually support UPI alongside card payments, but Apple and NPCI have not confirmed such integration or its timing. For now, Apple Pay's expected India launch should therefore be viewed primarily as a card-based contactless payment service, with UPI integration remaining a possible later addition. In Business Standard report, Pine Labs chief executive officer Amrish Rau had said that Apple Pay's entry could support growth in credit card transactions in India. During the company's Q1 earnings call, Rau said credit card transactions were already growing by around 10-15 per cent as credit cards and UPI continue to grow alongside each other. ALSO READ: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, SpaceXAI face lawsuit over 'AI slowdown pact'What changes with the new UPI MDRApple Pay's arrival also comes just before a major change in India's UPI pricing structure. From October 15, a 0.4 per cent MDR will apply to UPI merchant transactions above Rs 2,000. The fee will not apply to person-to-person transfers, while exemptions will cover small merchants and some essential sectors. This marks a change from UPI's long-standing zero-MDR model for merchants. The new fee is relevant to Apple Pay's India launch because it changes the economics around digital payments. However, the MDR applies to selected merchant transactions and is not a fee that consumers will pay every time they use UPI. Reuters reported that banks and payment providers are not allowed to pass the fee directly to consumers. That means the new UPI MDR does not automatically make Apple Pay cheaper for consumers. Apple Pay's initial proposition remains centred on using eligible credit cards through Apple devices, while UPI continues to operate as a bank-account-based payment system. ALSO READ: ASML begins India operations, plans to hire young engineering graduatesWhat does the launch mean for India's payments marketApple Pay is entering a market that already has a mature digital payments infrastructure. UPI processed 24.51 billion transactions in August, and NPCI has also recently introduced a UPI tap-and-pay feature using NFC. The feature allows users to make contactless UPI payments by tapping their smartphones on compatible point-of-sale terminals without opening a UPI app. This means Apple's arrival will not introduce contactless payments to India by itself. Instead, it will add Apple's hardware and card-based payment system to an ecosystem where UPI is already dominant. For Apple, the India launch also provides access to a growing credit card and premium smartphone user base. According to Counterpoint, Apple has captured around 8 per cent of India's smartphone market since 2022, while Reserve Bank of India (RBI) data shows Axis Bank had about 16.26 million active credit cards as of July. Apple Pay will enter India with a card-based payment model in a market where UPI is already widely used. Its adoption will depend on how easily it fits into existing payment habits and whether Apple adds UPI support in the future.

item.title: Crypto Can't Go Mainstream Without the Clarity Act
item.description: US regulators are determined to boost cryptoassets. That’s unsurprising when they owe their jobs to the meme-coin billionaire (and US President) Donald Trump. But after the Senate last week voted down the wide-ranging Clarity Act, any efforts by market watchdogs to codify rules for digital-asset markets risk being shot down by the next administration. And worse, the Supreme Court has already undercut agency rulemaking powers, anyway.

item.title: Australia apuesta por la inteligencia artificial para impulsar su economía durante las próximas décadas
item.description: El gobierno australiano prevé que la adopción de IA sostenga la productividad a largo plazo, mientras el crecimiento económico anual se desaceleraría al 2% hacia mediados de la década de 2060.
item.dc:creator: James Mayger
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — Australia se basará en la implantación y el desarrollo de la inteligencia artificial para impulsar el crecimiento económico durante los próximos 40 años, un periodo en el que es probable que la economía mundial se vuelva aún más fragmentada e impredecible. El Informe Intergeneracional de 2026 del Ministerio de Hacienda, publicado este lunes, señala que “el auge y la adopción de la IA probablemente contribuirán a alcanzar” su hipótesis de crecimiento de la productividad laboral a largo plazo del 1,2%, un nivel similar al del informe de 2023. Ver más: Confianza del consumidor en Australia se desploma por temor a tasas y alza del combustible “Nuestras ventajas de la década de 2010, la demanda china de materias primas, la educación y el turismo, darán paso a nuevas ventajas en el ámbito de las energías renovables y los minerales críticos, unas instituciones sólidas y alianzas estratégicas, así como servicios basados en la IA”, afirmó el ministro de Hacienda, Jim Chalmers, en un discurso pronunciado en la Universidad Nacional de Australia para dar a conocer las conclusiones. Chalmers, en respuesta a una pregunta sobre el nivel de la hipótesis de crecimiento de la productividad del Tesoro tras su discurso, señaló que “también existen riesgos al alza para esa cifra de productividad, por lo que consideramos que el 1,2% representa un equilibrio bastante eficaz”. El auge de los centros de datos ha sido uno de los pocos aspectos positivos de la economía australiana; Westpac Banking Corp. estima que tendrá una magnitud similar a la expansión del gas natural licuado de principios de la década de 2010. Sin embargo, a corto plazo, corre el riesgo de agravar las restricciones de oferta en la economía que han alimentado la inflación y obligado al Banco de la Reserva a subir las tasas de interés. El informe prevé que el crecimiento económico medio anual de Australia se ralentizará hasta el 2% a mediados de la década de 2060, frente al 3% registrado durante los 40 años anteriores. Se destaca que los conflictos y la competencia se están intensificando en todo el mundo. Si bien la apertura económica seguirá generando crecimiento, ejerciendo presión a la baja sobre la inflación e impulsando la productividad en Australia, los países y las empresas deberán encontrar un equilibrio entre la eficiencia de la cadena de suministro y la seguridad nacional, según se señala. “Los resultados económicos futuros dependerán de que se mantenga la apertura a las ventajas que ofrecen unos mercados que funcionen correctamente, al tiempo que se protege contra los efectos volátiles de la inestabilidad geopolítica”, se afirma. Chalmers señaló que la tasa de fertilidad de Australia está abocada a “descender aún más y más rápidamente” de lo previsto hace tan solo tres años. Se prevé que la población, estimada actualmente en 28,1 millones, alcance unos 39 millones a mediados de la década de 2060, por debajo de una proyección anterior de más de 40 millones, señaló. El informe “reafirma el hecho de que, durante las últimas décadas, y especialmente desde 2008, Australia ha dependido en exceso del crecimiento demográfico y muy poco de la mejora de la productividad para impulsar el crecimiento económico”, afirmó Stephen Smith, socio de Deloitte Access Economics. Ahora, ante la previsión de que el crecimiento demográfico disminuya en los próximos 40 años, la previsión de un aumento anual del 1,2% en la productividad laboral “parece depender cada vez más de hipotéticas mejoras de productividad derivadas de una implantación satisfactoria de la inteligencia artificial en toda la economía”, señaló. El informe destacó que las presiones sobre la equidad intergeneracional se están intensificando “debido a los retos a largo plazo en materia de vivienda, al cambio demográfico y a otras tendencias económicas estructurales”. El Ministerio de Hacienda estimó que “si las tasas de propiedad de la vivienda se hubieran mantenido en los niveles de 1981, los datos más recientes disponibles indican que alrededor de 250.000 hogares más, de personas de entre 25 y 34 años, serían propietarios de su propia vivienda”. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

FAST

DUBLIN, Sept 21 : The lead EU data privacy regulator for most of the biggest internet companies fined Alphabet's Google search engine €403 million ($463 million) after an inquiry into its processing of location data, Ireland's Data Protection Commission said on Monday. The Irish watchdog found that Google infringed European Union privacy rules known as the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) through three of its specific features – 'Web & App Activity', 'Location History' and 'Location Accuracy' — from 2018 to 2020. It was the fourth largest fine of the more than €4 billion in total levied by the DPC since it became the lead EU regulator for most big US tech firms under the strict 2018 GDPR due to the location of companies' EU operations in Ireland. Google was also ordered by the DPC to bring its processing into compliance within six months. The company did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment.

"As a result of Google's failures, individuals could have been unaware that their location was being used to, for example, influence them with ads or to infer their interests, and could lose control over their personal data," DPC Deputy Commissioner Graham Doyle said in a statement. "The retention of users' location data for longer than necessary aggravated this loss of control." The DPC opened the inquiry in 2020 following complaints from several European consumer rights organisations, including the pan-European consumers' organisation BEUC, regarding Google's processing of location data. The infringements included the lawfulness and fairness of Google's processing of location data in 'Web & App Activity', an account setting that processes information related to users’ activity on Google services, and 'Location History', which keeps track of users' location through mobile devices. Google is subject to three other ongoing statutory inquiries, all of which are at an advanced stage, the DPC added. ($1 = 0.8712 euros)

FAST

BERLIN, Sept 21 : Germany coach Juergen Klopp's decision to have two different squads with a total of 44 players for his first four international matches in charge has earned praise as he starts his bid to restore their international reputation as a football powerhouse. As the squad gathers on Monday at their base in Herzogenaurach, former Liverpool manager Klopp, who took over in July after Germany's shock 2026 World Cup exit, is already planning how to get the most out of his two sets of 22 players for the next four Nations League matches as he rebuilds the national team ahead of Euro 2028. Germany, four-times world champions, have suffered early eliminations in the last three World Cups and have had no international success since winning their last World Cup in 2014.  "I find that this is just an outstanding idea, that he invited 44 players," Germany's 1990 World Cup-winning captain Lothar Matthaeus said. "Not only the nominations but also the idea of the two squads."

"With four matches in nine or 10 days it just makes sense to have two squads, with the leagues and European competitions already under way. It is just superb," he said. MUSIALA AND KIMMICH The Germany lineups for their opening Nations League match against Netherlands in Amsterdam on Thursday and Greece in Augsburg on Sunday will include Jamal Musiala and captain Joshua Kimmich, but they will not feature against visitors Serbia and away to Greece. While Klopp hopes to collect valuable data, players will also benefit with a shorter absence from their clubs while also having a reduced international match schedule, with the club season under way. "An interesting idea from him to have two different teams for four matches," German Football Association Vice President Hans-Joachim Watzke said. "You have to first get the idea to do that. I like it." "I know he has long thought about it. I have a totally good feeling with the appointment of Juergen," said Watzke. "You shouldn't be thinking of Euro 2028 from September. There is still some time to experiment and if not now, then when?" Klopp, one of Germany's most prominent public figures, caused a stir during his squad unveiling on Thursday when he said he wanted to reclaim expressions of national pride from the "wrong people," in remarks widely seen as a rebuke to the far right.

item.title: Russie Le parti de Poutine remporte les élections législatives avec plus de 57% des voix
item.description: Le parti au pouvoir en Russie, "Russie unie", a largement remporté les élections législatives que le président russe Vladimir Poutine avait présentées comme un test de soutien à la guerre en Ukraine, a annoncé lundi la Commission électorale centrale, après le dépouillement de plus de 95% des bulletins.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Le parti au pouvoir en Russie, "Russie unie", a largement remporté les élections législatives que le président russe Vladimir Poutine avait présentées comme un test de soutien à la guerre en Ukraine, a annoncé lundi la Commission électorale centrale, après le dépouillement de plus de 95% des bulletins. "Russie Unie", le parti soutenu par Vladimir Poutine, a recueilli 57,83% des voix, soit une hausse de huit points de pourcentage par rapport aux 49,8% obtenus en 2021, lors des dernières élections à la Douma d'État, la chambre basse du Parlement. Ces résultats devraient permettre à "Russie unie" d'obtenir 355 sièges - contre 310 actuellement - sur 450. Le parti conforte ainsi sa majorité qualifiée - acquise au-delà de la barre des 300 - lui donnant la capacité à faire adopter des modifications constitutionnelles sans le soutien des autres partis. Peu de surprises étaient attendues en Russie dans un système politique étroitement contrôlé, qui selon ses détracteurs ne tolère aucune véritable dissidence. Selon les analystes politiques, il était important pour les autorités russes que le processus lui-même soit perçu comme s'étant déroulé sans heurts. Les responsables du pays avaient présenté ce scrutin comme un moyen de montrer à leurs ennemis que la Russie est unie. Ella Pamfilova, présidente de la Commission électorale centrale, a déclaré que le Parti communiste avait remporté 13,81% des voix et que le Parti libéral-démocrate de Russie, ultranationaliste, affichait un score de 8,98%. Le parti "Nouvelles personnes est crédité de 7,96%. Le parti "Russie juste" se situait quant à lui juste en dessous du seuil de 5% requis pour entrer au Parlement alors que le dépouillement touchait presque à sa fin, a ajouté Ella Pamfilova, soulignant qu'il avait "de grandes chances" de parvenir au seuil requis. Tous ces partis ont voté dans le même sens que "Russie unie" sur les questions majeures ces dernières années. PERCÉE RÉGIONALE D'UN PARTI ANTI-GUERRE En Tchétchénie, Ramzan Kadyrov, proche allié de Poutine, a été réélu pour un cinquième mandat à la tête de la république avec un score officiel avoisinant les 100%. Ella Pamfilova a déclaré que le taux de participation parmi les 111 millions d’électeurs russes – qu’elle a estimé à 59,3% – constituait un record pour ce type d’élection, qui s’est déroulée malgré une violente [USN:L8N45C029 TEXT:"attaque de drones"] ukrainiens contre Moscou dimanche, dernier jour du scrutin. Elle a également qualifié le scrutin de "transparent", face aux allégations de fraude généralisée formulées par des militants de l’opposition en exil. Le parti anti-guerre Iabloko, qui n'a pas réussi à obtenir de siège au niveau national en raison de l'interdiction pour nombre de ses membres de se présenter, semble toutefois avoir réussi à s’implanter modestement dans un parlement régional où se tenaient parallèlement des élections. À Novgorod, à environ 480km au nord-ouest de Moscou, avec près de 97% des voix dépouillées, le parti semblait avoir franchi la barre des 5% d’un point de pourcentage pour entrer au parlement régional. "Plus de 12.000 habitants de Novgorod ont soutenu Iabloko", a déclaré dans un communiqué le parti, qui prône un cessez-le-feu en Ukraine. "La paix, la liberté et une vie à l’abri de la peur sont des valeurs qui ont trouvé un écho dans le cœur et l’âme des gens."

item.title: Starbucks to establish its first India GCC in Chennai, create 800 tech jobs
item.description: The Starbucks GCC is expected to create 800 high-value jobs in its first phase, adding to Chennai's growing ecosystem of global capability centres ...
item.dc:creator: Shine Jacob
item.content:encoded: Adding to Tamil Nadu's growing global capability centre (GCC) ecosystem, the world's largest chain of coffee houses, Starbucks, has signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with the Government of Tamil Nadu to establish its GCC in Chennai. The GCC is expected to create 800 high-value jobs in its first phase, further strengthening Chennai’s position as a destination for global companies. The Starbucks investment also reflects Tamil Nadu’s increasingly hands-on approach to investment facilitation, said a government statement on Tuesday. During the course of discussions, when the proposal required further engagement, Minister for Industries and Investment S. Keerthana led the discussions with the Starbucks’ global team.  In a lighter note following the signing, Keerthana took to social media to mark the occasion with a nod to Tamil Nadu’s deep-rooted coffee culture, writing: _“We just brewed something strong. Tamil Nadu x Starbucks, a partnership blended to perfection.”_ She also noted that from rich filter kaapi to Starbucks, Tamil Nadu’s story is going global. Her continued engagement helped bring renewed attention to the opportunity and contributed to Starbucks moving forward with its Chennai GCC, the statement added.  The development is being seen as another outcome of the clear investment direction set by Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay. The Industries and Investment Promotion Department has been taking an active approach to identifying, facilitating and converting investment opportunities. “We are delighted to welcome Starbucks to Tamil Nadu. A global brand of Starbucks’ stature choosing Chennai to establish its GCC is a strong endorsement of our talent, our capabilities and the business environment we are building in Tamil Nadu,” Keerthana said.  “Our focus is clear: We want global companies to not only invest in Tamil Nadu, but build their next generation of capabilities here. We will continue to engage closely with investors and do everything possible to facilitate their growth in the state,” she said.  The Starbucks announcement adds to the growing momentum around Chennai’s GCC ecosystem. Recent GCC-related investments and MoUs include Nordex, Chubb, Walgreens, EY and Sigma Technology, alongside Starbucks. The government also announced three dedicated GCC corridors in Chennai with higher floor space index (FSI), aimed at enabling the development and expansion of large-scale global capability operations. With Starbucks joining this growing ecosystem, Tamil Nadu is strengthening its position as a destination where global companies can access skilled talent, build high-value capabilities and serve markets around the world. Tamil Nadu’s investment promotion approach is focused on turning opportunities into long-term partnerships, high-value employment and global capabilities.

Sept 21 : Mitsubishi Corp will more than triple its stake in Ayala Corp to 15 per cent in a 44.5 billion Philippine peso ($709.48 million) deal, the Philippine conglomerate said on Monday, deepening the Japanese firm's footprint in the country. At 650 Philippine pesos per share, the deal values Ayala at about 403.27 billion pesos, representing a nearly 22 per cent premium to its last closing price. The Japanese trading house, which currently holds a stake of 4.7 per cent according to Ayala, will also increase its voting stake to 20 per cent once the transaction is completed. The expanded alliance will deepen cooperation in consumer-facing businesses, while the two companies will also pursue opportunities across Ayala's core real estate and energy businesses, Mitsubishi said.

FAST

MADRID, Sept 21 : Artificial intelligence cannot be self-regulated by those who control the technology, Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez said on Monday. Governments worldwide are racing to set rules for AI as concerns grow over privacy, discrimination, job losses, misinformation and the concentration of computing power among a handful of tech giants. Speaking at an event on AI regulation in Madrid, Sanchez, an outspoken critic of "tech oligarchs", said his government would reinforce its defensive cybersecurity measures to respond to what he described as "aggressive" frontier AI models. He outlined a 12-month roadmap aimed at supporting responsible deployment and economic growth. The plan includes a proposed AI gigafactory as well as new models developed with the Barcelona Supercomputing Centre for climate, health and energy uses.

Sanchez said data centres needed to meet high environmental and energy standards while protecting data autonomy and benefiting local communities. "We must develop this technology not behind citizens' backs ... but in a way that people see it as an opportunity rather than a tool for depleting their scarce resources," he added. Sanchez's remarks came days after the heads of leading U.S. AI labs called for a slowdown in the technology's development, warning it could soon improve on its own and slip beyond human control.

item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Die Kreml-Partei Einiges Russland hat ihre Mehrheit bei der Parlamentswahl des Landes ausgebaut. Nach den am Montag von der Zentralen Wahlkommission veröffentlichten fast vollständigen Ergebnissen erhielt die Partei 57,83 Prozent der Stimmen. Bei der vergangenen Wahl zur Staatsduma im Jahr 2021 waren es 49,8 Prozent gewesen. Damit sicherte sich Einiges Russland 355 der 450 Sitze im Unterhaus und behält ihre verfassungsändernde Mehrheit, mit der sie Gesetze ohne die Unterstützung anderer Parteien verabschieden kann. Präsident Wladimir Putin hatte die dreitägige Wahl als Test für die Unterstützung des Krieges in der Ukraine bezeichnet. Es war die erste Wahl zur Staatsduma seit dem russischen Einmarsch in die Ukraine im Februar 2022. Auch die Kommunisten (13,81 Prozent), die ultranationalistische LDPR (8,98 Prozent) und die Partei Neue Leute (7,96 Prozent) schafften den Einzug ins Parlament. Diese Parteien hatten in den vergangenen Jahren bei wichtigen Fragen zumeist im Sinne von Einiges Russland gestimmt. ANTI-KRIEGS-PARTEI JABLOKO SCHEITERT Die einzige registrierte Anti-Kriegs-Partei, Jabloko, scheiterte am Einzug ins nationale Parlament. Viele ihrer Kandidaten waren von der Wahl ausgeschlossen worden. Allerdings gelang ihr im Regionalparlament von Nowgorod, rund 480 Kilometer nordwestlich von Moskau, offenbar der Sprung über die Fünf-Prozent-Hürde. "Frieden, Freiheit und ein Leben ohne Angst sind Werte, die in den Herzen und Seelen der Menschen einen Nerv getroffen haben", hieß es in einer Erklärung der Partei, die einen Waffenstillstand in der Ukraine befürwortet. Kritiker bemängeln, dass das politische System in Russland keinen echten Widerspruch dulde. In Tschetschenien wurde Machthaber Ramsan Kadirow nach offiziellen Angaben mit einem Ergebnis von fast 100 Prozent der Stimmen im Amt bestätigt. Der enge Verbündete Putins erhielt bei der Wahl zum Oberhaupt der südrussischen, mehrheitlich muslimischen Region 99,85 Prozent der Stimmen, wie die russische Wahlkommission mitteilte. Bei der Wahl 2021 hatte Kadirow 99,73 Prozent erhalten. Menschenrechtsorganisationen werfen seiner Regierung seit langem schwere Menschenrechtsverletzungen vor, unter anderem gegen Journalisten und Homosexuelle. Kadirow weist dies zurück. Die Vorsitzende der Wahlkommission, Ella Pamfilowa, sprach von einer Rekordbeteiligung von 59,3 Prozent. Sie bezeichnete die Wahl zudem als "sauber" und wies damit Vorwürfe von im Exil lebenden Oppositionellen über weitreichende Fälschungen zurück. Die Abstimmung war trotz eines schweren ukrainischen Drohnenangriffs auf Moskau am Sonntag, dem letzten Wahltag, fortgesetzt worden.

item.title: 中国、習近平国家主席の訪米を正式発表－首脳会談で通商やAI巡り協議
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 中国政府は21日、習近平国家主席がトランプ米大統領と会談するため、米国を訪問すると正式に発表した。米中の貿易戦争を巡る1年間の「休戦」措置が、期限を迎えつつある中での訪米となる。

中国外務省は今年5月、トランプ氏の招待を受け、習氏が秋に米国を公式訪問する予定だと説明していた。

中国外務省の郭嘉昆報道官によると、習氏は23－25日に国賓として米国を訪問する。郭氏は21日、北京での定例記者会見で、両国が「相違を適切に管理」するため共同で取り組む中で、習氏はトランプ氏と「二国間関係や世界の平和と発展に関わる重要な問題について踏み込んだ意見交換」を行うと説明した。

郭氏は「半年の間に両首脳が相互訪問することは、歴史的意義を持つ節目となる」とも強調した。トランプ氏と習氏は5月に北京で会談している。

習氏の訪米は、2023年にサンフランシスコでのアジア太平洋経済協力会議（APEC）首脳会議への出席と併せ、バイデン前米大統領と会談して以来となる。米中が昨年、韓国で取り決めた貿易戦争の休戦措置が延長されるとの観測は強まりつつあり、両国は米国産エネルギーや農産物などの製品への関税引き下げについて協議している。

首脳会談を前に、米中当局者は20日、ニューヨークでAIや貿易、投資を巡り協議した。ベッセント米財務長官は会談を「非常に成功した」と評価し、AIに関する対話の枠組みを設けることで両国が合意したと述べた。

トランプ氏は、習氏のために国賓晩餐会を開くとしており、アップルのティム・クック会長とオープンAIのサム・アルトマン最高経営責任者（CEO）が出席する見通しだ。

首脳会談では、イラン戦争やレアアースの供給、AIを巡る競争も議題となる可能性が高い。中国はイラン産原油の最大の買い手で、米国によるイランへの経済的締め付けの取り組みに対し、協力を急いでいないもようだ。

中国政府は、台湾の地位が数少ない譲れない一線の一つであることを、米国側に改めて伝える可能性が高い。米国は、中国が自国領とみなす台湾の最大の軍事・政治的支援国となっている。

item.title: ＶＷ・ポルシェ株続落、減損含む業績悪化警告で 追加人員削減報道も
item.description: ［フランクフルト ２１日 ロイター］ - 欧州自動車最大手のフォルクスワーゲン（ＶＷ）株が２１日序盤の取引で前週末に続...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＶＷ・ポルシェ株続落、減損含む業績悪化警告で　追加人員削減報道も 17:37 配信

資料写真：2025年5月14日、ドイツのドレスデンで行われたメディアツアー中、ドイツの自動車メーカー、フォルクスワーゲンの電気自動車「ID.3」の最終検査ラインにVWのロゴが見える。 REUTERS/Matthias Rietschel/File Photo

［フランクフルト　２１日　ロイター］ - 欧州自動車最大手のフォルクスワーゲン（ＶＷ）株が２１日序盤の取引で前週末に続き下落。高級スポーツカー部門ポルシェでの６０億ユーロ（６８億８０００万ドル）ののれん代減損を含む業績予想下方修正を嫌気した。

０７１３ＧＭＴ（日本時間午後４時１３分）時点で、ＶＷ株は２％安。ポルシェ株も２．８％下落した。１８日に同じく見通しを下方修正したＶＷの筆頭株主ポルシェＳＥも３．５％安となっている。

ＶＷは１８日、中国市場の低迷や退職引当金の増加、ポルシェの深刻な状況を理由に、２０２６年の利益率見通しを従来の４─５．５％から最大１％に引き下げた。

大きく依存していた中国、米国両市場の急激な変化が圧迫。中国市場で２４年に首位の座を失った。

アーノ・アントリッツ最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）はロイターが確認した社内メモで、世界最大の自動車市場である中国市場が２０％縮小していること、アジア勢が欧州市場で攻勢を強めていること、利益率の低い電気自動車（ＥＶ）の販売が増えていることに言及し、「時間を失う余裕はない」と述べた。

さらに１９日、ＶＷの大規模再建計画には、ポルシェでさらに４０００人超削減する案が含まれていると独経済紙ハンデルスブラットが報じた。

ハンデルスブラットによると、ＶＷ監査役会が最近合意した、独自動車グループとして過去最大規模の再編に関する文書では、ポルシェで「約４１００人」の人員削減を提案している。約７億ユーロ（８億３８０万ドル）の間接費不足の解消を目指すという。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：エネルギー高・金利高の二重苦、世界の株価を圧迫へ コラム：円急伸で揺らぐキャリートレード、見つからない次の調達通貨 アングル：世界市場が当面向き合う6つのリスク、地政学や金融政策・ＡＩなど 焦点：米国株の強さ再び、「ＴＩＡＲＡ」取引衰え「ＴＩＮＡ」取引が復活 アングル：中東緊迫で市場は2022年の教訓参照　ロシアのウクライナ侵攻時の動き再検証 最終更新: 9/21(月) 17:37 ロイター

item.title: 習主席の訪米発表、重要問題でトランプ氏と意見交換と中国外務省
item.description: ［北京 ２１日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［北京　２１日　ロイター］ - 中国外務省は２１日の声明で、習近平国家主席がトランプ米大統領の招待により２３─２５日に米国を公式訪問すると発表した。

発表後の定例記者会見で、郭嘉昆報道官は、習氏が訪問中に「中米関係や世界の平和と発展に関する重要問題について、トランプ氏と踏み込んだ意見交換を行う」と述べた。

両国首脳が６カ月以内に相互訪問することは「歴史的かつ画期的な意義がある」とし、「中国は米国と協力し、対話と協力を強化し、相違を適切に管理した上で、両国民の幸福を絶えず向上させ、世界の平和と安定、繁栄を促進する用意がある」と述べた。

FAST

MILAN, Sept 21 : Central banks need to understand who benefits from artificial intelligence-driven gains, as their distribution will help shape aggregate demand and inflation, European Central Bank Governing Council member Fabio Panetta said on Monday. • AI is set to transform productivity and growth, labour and financial markets, and payment systems, Panetta said. • If AI mainly creates new tasks and raises expected labour income, demand could increase before AI's full productivity benefits materialise, prolonging inflationary pressures, he added. • Panetta, who is also governor of the Bank of Italy, was speaking at an event hosted by the National Bank of Ukraine.

• Credibility is an essential asset of every central bank, but how it is built and preserved depends on the nature of the challenges faced, he said. • Central banks cannot remain on the sidelines, Panetta said, adding that understanding changes underway is increasingly essential to central bank credibility. • According to Panetta, if automation dominates, weaker consumption could cause the disinflationary effects of AI to emerge sooner.

China confirms Xi to visit the US this week for Trump talks

Xi will hold "in-depth exchanges of views with President Trump on major issues concerning China-US relations, as well as world peace and development", says a Chinese foreign ministry spokesperson.

US President Donald Trump participates in a welcome ceremony with China's President Xi Jinping at the Great Hall of the People, May 14, 2026, in Beijing, China. (File photo: AP/Mark Schiefelbein)

FAST

BEIJING: Chinese President Xi Jinping will pay a state visit to the US from Sep 23 to 25 at the invitation of President Donald Trump, China's Foreign Ministry confirmed in a statement on Monday (Sep 21). During the visit, Xi "will hold in-depth exchanges of views with President Trump on major issues concerning China- US relations, as well as world peace and development", a Chinese foreign ministry spokesperson said during a regular press conference shortly after the announcement. Xi and Trump are expected to hold talks in Washington on Thursday, their second summit this year following Trump’s state visit to Beijing in May. Trade and tariffs, artificial intelligence, Taiwan and the war in Iran are among the issues expected to feature in their discussions. The reciprocal visits by the two heads of state within a six-month period are "of historic, milestone significance," Chinese foreign ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun said on Monday. "China is willing to work with the US to ... strengthen dialogue and cooperation, properly manage differences, continuously enhance the well-being of the peoples of both countries, and promote world peace, stability and prosperity," Guo added. Trump plans to personally greet Xi when he arrives at Joint Base Andrews on Wednesday, before hosting him for a state dinner at the White House the following day, Reuters reported on Saturday, citing senior US officials.

item.title: Volkswagen to ramp up restructuring after profit warning
item.description: Volkswagen will ramp up its restructuring programme, the head of its core brand said on Monday as German auto workers staged nationwide protests less than three days after the company's profit warning highlighted sectoral challenges from high costs and fierce Asian competition.
item.dc:creator: Christoph Steitz, Rachel More
item.content:encoded: Volkswagen will [USN:L8N45D0LM TEXT:"ramp up"] its restructuring programme, the head of its core brand said on Monday as German auto workers staged nationwide protests less than three days after the company's [USN:L1N45A0LS TEXT:"profit warning"] highlighted sectoral challenges from high costs and fierce Asian competition. The protests at Volkswagen , BMW (BMWG.DE) and parts supplier Bosch are in response to painful job cuts, possible production relocations and even plant closures for Germany's most important industry in a crisis that was also reflected in the result of two state elections on Sunday. "I had hoped that the measures agreed in 2024 would already be sufficient. Unfortunately, that has not been the case," Volkswagen brand head Thomas Schaefer told a staff meeting at the company's Wolfsburg headquarters. 'NO TIME TO LOSE' "We have absolutely no time to lose and will therefore significantly step up our performance programme once again," he said, adding that the company and employee representatives will discuss how to proceed. Europe's biggest carmaker plans to cut a further 50,000 jobs as part of a massive restructuring agreed with stakeholders this month, averting a full-blown dispute with powerful unions that still repeated calls on management to fix the issues. Volkswagen works council chief Daniela Cavallo and IG Metall union head Christiane Benner [USN:L8N45D0FK TEXT:"called for stronger protection"] against unfair competition from China, a more effective European Union subsidy policy and continuation of a phased retirement programme. "We expect corporate leaders and management teams to take responsibility for Germany as an automotive nation, for employees and for jobs," Benner told workers at Volkswagen's headquarters. European automakers are facing increased competition from Asian rivals abroad and at home, creating a major problem for Volkswagen as it contends with overcapacity on the continent, US tariffs and plunging profits in China. Volkswagen cut its 2026 profit margin outlook last week to 1% at the most, blaming the sluggish Chinese market and higher provisions for retirements while also lowering expectations for its Porsche (P911_p.DE) sports car brand. Part of the problem was accelerated demand for less profitable electric vehicles, highlighting the sector's dependence on combustion engines that have fuelled Germany's economy for decades. "Most managers have failed to keep pace with developments in e-mobility, digitalisation and battery technology, thereby causing the German automotive and supplier industries to fall behind," said Horst Ott of trade union IG Metall. Volkswagen shares, which were excluded from the benchmark Euro Stoxx 50 index (.STOXX50E) on Monday, fell 1.1% by 1148 GMT, while Porsche dropped 1.6%, extending Friday's declines. Shares in Porsche SE (PSHG_p.DE) — Volkswagen's biggest shareholder, which also cut 2026 guidance on Friday — were down 3.1%. ($1 = 0.8715 euros)

item.title: La señal cambiaria que dejó el Presupuesto y cómo impacta la decisión de la Fed, según Santiago Bulat
item.description: El economista de Invecq e IDEA considera que las proyecciones del Gobierno para 2027 son más realistas que las incluidas en el Presupuesto anterior. Qué sugiere sobre la apreciación cambiaria y optimi ...
item.dc:creator: Tomás Carrió
item.content:encoded: Buenos Aires — El proyecto de ley de Presupuesto 2027 plantea supuestos macroeconómicos más “realistas” que los del año previo, aunque el gobierno de Javier Milei mantiene un sesgo optimista respecto de variables sensibles a la sociedad como la tasa de crecimiento o la recuperación del salario y del consumo. También sugiere que el proceso de apreciación cambiaria no se prolongará durante el año electoral, más allá de que se descuenta que el equipo económico seguirá interviniendo para contener episodios de volatilidad. Estas son dos de las principales conclusiones que dejó para Santiago Bulat, economista jefe de IDEA y socio de la consultora Invecq, la ‘ley de leyes’ presentada esta semana al Congreso. VER MÁS: Presupuesto 2027: qué plantea el Gobierno de Milei para la inflación, el PBI y el dólar En diálogo con Bloomberg Línea , Bulat destacó en primer término que el proyecto remitido esta semana “es un Presupuesto mucho más realista respecto al del año pasado”, que había anticipado un crecimiento del 5% e inflación de 10%, cuando el mercado anticipaba una desaceleración respecto del año previo, pero menos abrupta (20%). “Terminamos con una inflación que ahora va a estar cerca de 30% y para el año que viene, en vez de decir que va a ser un dígito, como se planteaba en el Presupuesto de 2025, están diciendo que va a ser 18%”, dijo antes de recordar que el último Relevamiento de Expectativas del Mercado del Banco Central (BCRA) refleja que analistas privados proyectan para 2027 una tasa de inflación apenas superior al 20%. “Esa distancia que había respecto a lo que el mercado esperaba es notablemente menor y eso me parece mucho mejor para un presupuesto, mucho más claro y creíble”, marcó. Aun así, el economista ve que el proyecto refleja que el Gobierno mantiene un sesgo más optimista que el mercado en términos de actividad económica, recuperación del salario real y del consumo. Respecto del crecimiento, dijo que en Invecq proyectan que se mantenga por debajo de 3%, en línea con este año o levemente por encima. “El crecimiento está impactado por más de un 9% de aumento de la inversión y ahí es donde tengo dudas, aunque hace sentido que si las importaciones suben los niveles de inversión también crezcan. Parece un crecimiento muy importante”, dijo Bulat. VER MÁS: Economía argentina anota primer trimestre de contracción desde 2024 Respecto de las perspectivas oficiales de recuperación del salario real, señaló que espera que haya recomposición, sobre todo en la primera parte del año por el arrastre de un 2026 que será más inflacionario de lo esperado, aunque espera que sea algo más moderada que la recomposición cercana a 7 puntos que espera el equipo económico. “No sé si va a llegar una recuperación tan fuerte real, con lo cual el consumo quizás está un poquito por encima de nuestras expectativas”. En lo que refiere a las cifras para el tipo de cambio que figuran en el Presupuesto 2027, que el Gobierno se encargó de aclarar que no representan una proyección, el economista analizó: “Lo cambiario también va en una tónica muy parecida a lo que espera el mercado, tanto Focus como REM, de terminar con la apreciación cambiaria, que haya llegado a su tope y que a partir de ahora sea un proceso que acompañe más a la inflación”. “No creo que vayan a buscar más apreciación de donde ya estábamos. Sí creo que lo que quieren evitar es la alta volatilidad del año pasado”, consideró . Para ello, añadió que el Banco Central y el Tesoro, vía compras de reservas y colocaciones en el mercado local con Bonares a 2027, 2028 y 2029, “llegan más armados” que el año anterior. Para Bulat, las intervenciones recientes del BCRA en dólar linked y futuros no apuntan a contener el tipo de cambio y apreciarlo, sino para que se reduzca la volatilidad. Y hacia adelante, cree que el esquema cambiario mantendrá esa dinámica en la que el tipo de cambio acompañe a la inflación pero con baja volatilidad, aunque recuerda que dependerá también de los flujos y de los precios externos. ¿Puede eso significar que el equipo económico deba soltar un poco el apretón sobre las tasas? El economista cree que sí y recuerda que “en el último tiempo estamos viendo tasas un poco más al alza”. “Si uno ve la TAMAR en los últimos 40 días, está casi dos puntos y medio arriba. Es una tasa que de alguna manera expresa lo que va a pasar hacia adelante con el tipo de cambio”, expresó. Es que según explica, el riesgo de llegar muy apreciado al 2027 electoral es que la expectativa de devaluación pueda ser mayor hacia adelante y eso demande una tasa mayor a la que hay ahora. Para que la tasa no se vea afectada por una mayor volatilidad, cree que es necesario que se vea un riesgo país un poco menor y una inflación que siga descendiendo. “Si vemos estos niveles de inflación y llegamos con un tipo de cambio en torno a ARS$1.500, creo que la expectativa de devaluación te va a exigir una tasa un poco más alta”, expresó. VER MÁS: Compras de reservas y deuda en pesos: la encrucijada que enfrenta Milei rumbo a 2027 Esa búsqueda de un riesgo país más bajo pareció recibir un contratiempo esta semana, después de que la Reserva Federal de los Estados Unidos (Fed) convalidara la primera suba de tasas en tres años. Habitualmente, el hike sugeriría cierto viento de frente para los países emergentes, haciendo que la posibilidad de acceso a los mercados internacionales se aleje para Argentina. Pero para Bulat, ese viento externo no está soplando en contra. “Cuando veo la tasa de los bonos del Tesoro estadounidense en torno a 5%, con una tasa de interés que hay que mirarla en términos reales, con una inflación que todavía no está cediendo lo que el banco central hubiera esperado, no deja de ser una tasa nominal alta pero no necesariamente la tasa real más alta del último tiempo”, analizó. Pero además, el economista recordó que desde que asumió Donald Trump no se está dando la habitual correlación entre la suba de tasas de un bono del Tesoro y apreciación del dólar. “Creo que tiene que ver con temas fiscales, con dudas respecto a Estados Unidos. Entonces lo que uno hubiera pensado, esta suba de tasas me va a complicar mucho, en el inicio no está pasando”, dijo. “Los mercados emergentes siguen recibiendo flujos de inversión muy fuertes, no pareciera haber ahí un parate todavía. Y en la parte externa de precios y lo que Argentina exporta, soja subiendo, trigo subiendo, maíz arriba del año pasado, oro, plata y petróleo subiendo, si tengo que pensar los inflows y outflows , por ahora te da bastante positivo”, cerró. VER MÁS: Decisión clave de la Fed de Warsh: qué esperar para los bonos argentinos si suben las tasas

item.title: ロシア下院選、与党・統一ロシアが圧勝－政権の厳しい統制下
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： ウクライナ侵攻後初めて行われたロシア下院選で、プーチン大統領の与党「統一ロシア」が圧勝した。選挙は大統領府の厳しい統制下で実施され、投票用紙には反対勢力が実質的にいなかった。

国営通信が中央選挙管理委員会の集計として伝えたところによると、開票率90%の段階で統一ロシアの得票率は約58%。共産党が13.84%で続き、民族主義色の強い自由民主党は8.9%だった。

統一ロシアは2003年以降、下院で過半数を維持している。改選前と同様、憲法改正に必要な3分の2超の議席を確保する見通しだ。

下院（定数450）の半数は政党名簿、残る半数は小選挙区で選ばれる。国営テレビによると、中央選挙管理委員会は投票率を57%と発表。21年の前回選挙を上回った。

現実路線と企業寄りの政策を掲げる「新しい人々」は7.94%を獲得し、議席獲得に必要な5%を超えて下院に戻る見通しだ。ロシアの国営通信社RIAノーボスチによると、左派「公正ロシア」はモスクワ時間21日午前8時（日本時間同日午後2時）時点で4.95%にとどまっており、議席を得られるかはなお不透明だ。

大統領府は今回の選挙を通じ、5年目に入ったウクライナでの戦争への強い支持を示す狙いがあった。ロシア軍は戦場で大きな犠牲を出す一方、進展は乏しい。選挙後、数十万人を軍に徴集する新たな大規模動員に大統領府が踏み切るのではないかとの不安がロシア国内に広がっている。

投票用紙に名を連ねたすべての政党は、ウクライナでの戦争をめぐりプーチン氏を支持し、国内政策への批判も控えた。

リベラル派「ヤブロコ」が「平和と自由」を掲げて選挙戦に臨むと表明したが、ロシア最高裁は先月、選挙規則違反を理由にヤブロコを下院選の政党名簿から除外した。一部の候補者は小選挙区で立候補を続けた。

原題：Putin’s Ruling Party Wins Big in Controlled Parliament Vote (1)（抜粋）

item.title: 北朝鮮、他国との協力阻害「容認せず」 国連監視報告書を非難
item.description: ［ソウル ２１日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［ソウル　２１日　ロイター］ - 北朝鮮は２１日、他国との協力を阻もうとする敵対勢力の動きを容認しないと表明し、いかなる新たな制裁も自国の発展や核心的利益の防衛を妨げることはないと述べた。国営朝鮮中央通信（ＫＣＮＡ）が外務省報道官の声明として報じた。

声明は、北朝鮮による制裁違反や制裁逃れを追跡・報告する国連加盟１１カ国のグループ「多国間制裁監視チーム（ＭＳＭＴ）」について、北朝鮮が他国との正常で互恵的な経済協力としているものを違法と見なすよう仕向ける目的で報告書をでっち上げたと非難した。

ＭＳＭＴは１６日に発表した報告書で、北朝鮮が国連安全保障理事会の決議に違反して海外への労働者派遣を続けており、核兵器や弾道ミサイル計画の資金として２０２５年に推定４億５０００万─８億ドルを生み出したと指摘した。

また、推定３万５６００─１０万１２８０人の北朝鮮労働者が、主に中国やロシアなど少なくとも１７カ国で現在も活動しているとし、各国に対し北朝鮮労働者の送還と新たな労働許可の拒否により直ちに国連決議を履行するよう求めた。

ＭＳＭＴの参加国は、米国、日本、韓国、豪州、カナダ、英国、フランス、ドイツ、イタリア、オランダ、ニュージーランド。

item.title: China's 13-year-old Yu smashes Asian record for stunning 200m medley gold
item.description: Yu touched in two minutes, 6.10 seconds to smash runner-up Yu Yiting's Asian record and fall only four-tenths of a second short of 20-year-old McIntosh's world record.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: China's 13-year-old swimming sensation Yu Zidi lit up the Asian Games pool again on Monday as she claimed the 200 metres individual medley gold medal with a blistering time that will put Canadian dynamo Summer McIntosh on notice. Yu touched in two minutes, 6.10 seconds at the Tokyo Aquatic Centre to smash runner-up Yu Yiting's Asian record (2:06.82) and fall only four-tenths of a second short of 20-year-old McIntosh's world record (2:05.70). "Very excited, very happy. It's an achievement that shows the hard work of our team," said Yu, who won the 200m butterfly on Sunday. "I'm happier with the second gold medal than the first. "She's a strong opponent who motivates me to improve and work harder," she added of 21-year-old Chinese teammate Yu. Already Asia's fastest in the women's medley at 13, Yu's stunning trajectory raises questions of how much stronger she will be at the Los Angeles Olympics. It could mean a battle royale in LA against McIntosh, who won the 200 and 400 IM double at the Paris Games. At 12, Yu became the youngest world championship medallist with a bronze in China's 4x200 freestyle relay team in Singapore. Her global success at such a young age raised concerns from child protection experts but Hong Kong swimmer Siobhan Haughey said Yu looks ready for the Olympics. "I think she's doing well under pressure at big meets," she said. "I think if she wants to do it, she definitely can." Former world champion Haughey successfully defended her Asian Games gold medal in the 200m freestyle on Monday with a dominant win over Chinese duo Li Jiaping and Liu Yaxin. Haughey said young swimmers like Yu were exciting for the sport but at 28, she was glad to hold her own. "On one hand it makes me feel I'm twice their age, but I'm still here, so that says something," she said. "I think being an older swimmer means I have a lot more experience, and I try to use that experience to my advantage, for instance like how to handle pressure or what to expect at a big meet."

item.title: オープンＡＩ、30年までに2800億ドルの現金消費を予測＝ＦＴ
item.description: [１８日 ロイター] - 対話型人工知能（ＡＩ）「チャットＧＰＴ」を手がけるオープンＡＩは、計算能力やインフラへの支出...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
オープンＡＩ、30年までに2800億ドルの現金消費を予測＝ＦＴ 15:56 配信

写真はオープンＡＩのロゴ。６月撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

[１８日 ロイター] - 対話型人工知能（ＡＩ）「チャットＧＰＴ」を手がけるオープンＡＩは、計算能力やインフラへの支出拡大に伴い、２０２６年から３０年にかけて２７８０億ドルの現金消費（キャッシュバーン）を見込んでいると、英紙フィナンシャル・タイムズ（ＦＴ）が１８日、同社のプレゼンテーション資料を引用して報じた。

この見通しは、オープンＡＩが新たな投資を求める中で、資金調達ニーズが高まっていることを浮き彫りにしている。

• ＦＴによると、オープンＡＩは２６年から３０年までの５年間でフリーキャッシュフローが２７８０億ドルのマイナスになると見込んでいる一方で、ＡＩモデルの訓練と運用に必要な計算能力を確保するために積極的な投資を行っている。

• オープンＡＩはまた、同期間に売上高が１０倍に増加し、今年の３６０億ドルから３０年には３５００億ドルに達すると見込んでおり、３０年末までに累計で８４００億ドルの売上高を生み出すと予想しているという。

• ３０年末までにオープンＡＩが見込む計算能力とインフラへの支出は約８５６０億ドルで、同社にとって最大の支出項目になるという。ＦＴは、同社が３月に企業価値８５２０億ドルで１２２０億ドルを調達したが、２８年までにその資金を使い果たす見通しだとしている。

• オープンＡＩのコメントは得られていない。

item.title: 中国共産党５中全会、10月26─29日開催 厳格な党統治推進など協議
item.description: ［北京 ２１日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［北京　２１日　ロイター］ - 中国国営の新華社通信は２１日、共産党中央委員会第５回全体会議（５中全会）が１０月２６─２９日に開催されると報じた。

５中全会では、「全面的かつ厳格な党統治を持続的に推進する上での重要な問題」を中心に協議する。党の最高意思決定機関の中で最大規模の一つである中央委員会の委員と候補委員、計３００人超が出席する。

新華社によると、共産党は２１日、習近平国家主席主宰の政治局会議を開き、党内統治と規律について議論した。政治局会議の公式要約によると、党全体として「党建設が直面する顕著な問題に適切に対処・解決し、党の管理・統治を通じて形成された良好な政治状況を強固にし、発展させなければならない」とした。

通常、５年に１度開催される党大会の間に、中央委員会の全体会議は７回開かれる。党規約は少なくとも年１回の全体会議開催を義務付けている。

今回の会議は、２０２２年に発足した現中央委員会にとって５回目の全体会議となる。

item.title: 米英中銀、ＡＩファンド巨額損失巡り大手銀のエクスポージャー調査＝ＦＴ
item.description: ［２１日 ロイター］ - イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）と米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）は、人工知能（ＡＩ）特化型ヘッジフ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米英中銀、ＡＩファンド巨額損失巡り大手銀のエクスポージャー調査＝ＦＴ 15:44 配信

米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の建物　2020年5月撮影　REUTERS/Kevin Lamarque/File Photo

［２１日　ロイター］ - イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）と米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）は、人工知能（ＡＩ）特化型ヘッジファンド「シチュエーショナル・アウェアネス」への投資で米クオンツ取引大手ジェーン・ストリートが巨額の損失を抱えたことを受け、グローバル銀行に大規模トレーディング会社へのエクスポージャーを問い合わせている。英紙フィナンシャル・タイムズ（ＦＴ）が２１日報じた。

シチュエーショナル・アウェアネスは、元オープンＡＩ研究者のレオポルド・アシェンブレナー氏が運用するファンド。ＡＩ・半導体株の急落を受けて運用資産価値が急減し、保有する公開株ポートフォリオの大半をシタデル・セキュリティーズに売却せざるを得なくなった。これにより、ジェーン・ストリートでは７月に約１５０億ドルの損失を計上した。

関係者の話としてＦＴが報じたところによると、英米中銀は現在、トレーディング会社のリスク選好、取引時間中の銀行のエクスポージャーの推移、リスク管理の機能の仕方について情報提供を求めている。

ロイターはこの報道を独自に確認できていない。米ＦＲＢ、英中銀、ジェーン・ストリートは、営業時間外のロイターのコメント要請に直ちに応じなかった。

先月、米証券取引委員会（ＳＥＣ）は、ゴールドマン・サックス、ＪＰモルガン、シティグループ、バンク・オブ・アメリカなどの米金融大手に召喚状を出した。ＳＥＣはシチュエーショナル・アウェアネスが破綻の危機に瀕したことを受け、同ファンドのマージンコール（追加証拠金）を引き起こした取引や貸し手とのやり取りも含め、取引活動やレバレッジの利用について調査している。

item.title: ベトナム株、ＦＴＳＥラッセル新興国指数に組み入れ
item.description: [ハノイ ２１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ハノイ ２１日 ロイター] - ベトナム株が２１日、指数算出会社ＦＴＳＥラッセルの新興国指数に組み入れられた。外国人投資家の誘致を目指して長年改革に取り組んできた同国市場にとって大きな節目となった。

ＦＴＳＥラッセルは今回の組み入れにより、最大６０億ドルがベトナムに流入する可能性があるとの見通しを示している。ベトナムは２０１８年から、中国やインドも含まれる区分への組み入れに向けたウオッチリストに指定されていた。

移行は２７年にかけて４段階で行われ、２６年９月に１０％、２７年３月に２０％、同年６月と９月に３５％ずつ組み入れられる予定だ。

ＭＳＣＩによる格上げへの期待も高まっている。投資家らは、２７年に予定される中央清算システムの導入が、ＭＳＣＩの市場アクセス要件を満たす一助になる可能性があるとしている。

item.title: トランプ氏、ワシントン凱旋門を軍事施設に 無人機・狙撃兵を配備
item.description:
Nathan Layne Anusha Shah
[２０日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Nathan Layne　Anusha Shah

[２０日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２０日、首都ワシントン近郊に建設を計画している凱旋門について、ドローン（無人機）や狙撃兵を配備する「軍事施設」を兼ねると述べた。国家安全保障を理由に正当化しようとする大規模建設プロジェクトとしては２件目となる。

トランプ氏は、この計画は軍の要請によるものだと述べた。ホワイトハウスの東棟跡地に建設中の約４億ドル規模のボールルーム（宴会場）複合施設を擁護する際にも国家安全保障上の理由を持ち出していた。トランプ氏は具体的な脅威については言及しなかった。

トランプ氏はソーシャルメディアへの投稿で、軍からの「強い要請」を受け、計画されている高さ２５０フィート（７６メートル）の凱旋門を「最高級の軍事複合施設兼凱旋門」に変えることに同意したと述べた。屋上と広場の両方に多数のドローンと狙撃兵を配備し、迅速に展開できる能力を備えるほか、大量の狙撃用弾薬を保管するという。

米軍当局者はロイターに対し、国防総省はトランプ氏のソーシャルメディアへの投稿以外に付け加えることはないと述べた。ホワイトハウスはコメント要請に直ちには回答しなかった。

トランプ氏は、凱旋門にそのような能力が必要な理由について詳しく説明しなかった。

item.title: 南北非武装地帯で韓国兵3人負傷、巡回路整備中に地雷爆発
item.description: ［ソウル ２１日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［ソウル　２１日　ロイター］ - 韓国の李在明大統領と同国軍合同参謀本部は２１日、南北軍事境界線を挟む非武装地帯（ＤＭＺ）の西部区域で作戦実施中に地雷が爆発し、兵士３人が負傷したと発表した。

合同参謀本部によると、爆発はＤＭＺ内の軍事境界線（ＭＤＬ）より南側で発生した。負傷した３人のうち２人がヘリコプターで搬送され、治療を受けているとした。残る１人と、作戦に参加した他の兵士は診断を受けるため病院に搬送されるという。負傷の程度は明らかにしなかった。

李大統領はＸへの投稿で、兵士らがＤＭＺ内の巡回路を整備していた際、地雷の爆発が起きたと説明。負傷した兵士らの早期回復を願うとともに、治療とリハビリテーションに必要な政府支援を全て提供すると表明した。

ＤＭＺ内やその周辺では、地雷などによる爆発が繰り返し発生している。

北朝鮮軍は３月に軍事境界線付近で地雷敷設やフェンス建設などの要塞化作業を再開したと報じられている。

韓国の国会議員は今月、北朝鮮が設置した地雷原や他の施設がＤＭＺ西部区域の６カ所で、軍事境界線を約１０─１５メートル越えていると指摘した。

FAST

BANGKOK, Sept 21 : Thailand is considering an oil tax cut, Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas said on Monday. • Ekniti said cutting the excise tax on fuel would help ease the cost-of-living burden on the public caused by the energy crisis. • The tax cut is being considered because almost all other measures have been exhausted, he said, noting that Thailand has already cut refinery margins to lower fuel costs and tapped its Oil Fuel Fund to stabilise prices. • The tax cuts would apply to blended biofuels like E20 and B20, which would help farmers, Ekniti added. • "Any tax cut would be designed not to affect Thailand's fiscal position, which is one of the key strengths considered by credit rating agencies," he said. • Ekniti said he would also seek approval for an extension to the consumer subsidy scheme at a cabinet meeting on Tuesday.

Source: Reuters

item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： フランスの銀行ソシエテ・ジェネラルのスラヴォミール・クルパ最高経営責任者（CEO）は同行の収益性目標を引き上げた。新戦略でコスト削減と株主還元の拡大を目指している。

21日の発表資料によると、29年の有形自己資本利益率（ROTE）の目標を13－14%に引き上げ、それ以降は15%超とする。26年のROTE目標は約11%としている。

29年までの株主還元については、少なくとも210億ユーロ（3兆7800億円）の達成を目指すとした。

クルパ氏は発表資料で「われわれは今日、新たな段階に入る」としたうえで、「目標は明確だ。収益を伴う成長を加速し、リスクとコスト管理を徹底する」と表明した。

クルパ氏が3年前に打ち出した前戦略は株価上昇につながった。 これまでに経営陣を刷新し、柔軟な在宅勤務制度を終了したほか、約3000人の人員削減を発表した。

クルパ氏は今回、今後3年間で26年の推定コストを基準に約2%削減する新たな経費削減策を発表した。一方、収入は年約3%の伸びを見込む。これにより経費率は55%未満に改善するとの見通しを示した。

ソシエテによると、経費節減は人員減に加え、IT支出と調達費の削減で実現する見通しだ。AIの活用も寄与するとした。ソシエテは具体的な人員削減数を示さず、「自然減」によって削減を進めるとした。

クルパ氏は、現行の株主還元方針に沿って、純利益の50%を株主に還元する方針だ。現金配当と自社株買いを「バランスの取れた」形で組み合わせる。

さらに、普通株式等Tier1（CET1）比率の目標（13%超）を上回る余剰資本も還元する方針だ。

原題：SocGen Raises Profitability Goal to At Least 13% in New Plan (1)（抜粋）
